text: This is Rembrandt's The Night Watch, painted in sixteen forty-two. But the name is not Rembrandt's. According to the museum, it is first found in writing in seventeen ninety-seven. An early description, kept by the captain's family, says nothing about the night.
spoken_text: This is Rembrandt's The Night Watch, painted in sixteen forty-two. But the name is not Rembrandt's. According to the museum, it is first found in writing in seventeen ninety-seven. An early description, kept by the captain's family, says nothing about the night.
phonemes: ðɪs ɪz ɹᵻmbɹˈænts ðə nˈaɪt wˈɑːtʃ, pˈeɪntᵻd ɪn sˈɪkstiːn fˈɔːɹɾitˈuː. bˌʌt ðə nˈeɪm ɪz nˌɑːt ɹᵻmbɹˈænts. ɐkˈɔːɹdɪŋ tə ðə mjuːzˈiəm, ɪɾ ɪz fˈɜːst fˈaʊnd ɪn ɹˈaɪɾɪŋ ɪn sˈɛvəntˌiːn nˈaɪntisˈɛvən. ɐn ˈɜːli dᵻskɹˈɪpʃən, kˈɛpt baɪ ðə kˈæptɪnz fˈæmɪli, sˈɛz nˈʌθɪŋ ɐbˌaʊt ðə nˈaɪt.
